headline: MPS Limited NCLT Shareholder Meeting Convened
sum: MPS Limited held an NCLT-convened shareholder meeting on 22 August 2026 to consider a scheme of arrangement or restructuring under Companies Act Section 230–232.
implication: NCLT-convened shareholder meetings signal a formal corporate restructuring (merger, demerger, or scheme of arrangement) where the tribunal has already satisfied itself on prima facie grounds before shareholder approval; outcomes are subject to post-meeting NCLT sanction order, creating a two-stage regulatory gate.
detail: The shareholder meeting was convened by NCLT order (typical under Section 230 or 232 of the Companies Act, 2013) to seek equity shareholder approval for a scheme. The exchange intimation confirms proceedings were held on 22 August 2026. Full scheme details, consideration, counterparties, and post-meeting NCLT approval timeline remain to be disclosed in subsequent filings.
